artifacts.summary: All 5 phases complete: suite_selection_select's multi-path aggregation is now compositional, its two production call sites (Gate 8 narrowing, Tier Justification check) are adapted, plan-format.md's authoring contract documents the mixed-set case, the new semantics are pinned with fixtures across three suites, and the deployed tree has been regenerated and verified byte-identical to the source store.

completion_data.completion_summary: Fixed suite_selection_select's sentinel-domination defect by making its multi-path aggregation compositional (the sentinel is now a floor contributed by its own member, never a ceiling over the whole set), adapted verify-deploy.sh's Gate 8 narrowing and validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification check to the new contract, updated plan-format.md's authoring contract, pinned the semantics with fixtures in three test suites, and redeployed with confirmed source-store/deployed parity.

memory_candidates.content: When regression-testing a fallback-to-full-battery behavior in verify-deploy.sh's Gate 8 (--gate8-touched), a fixture asserting only 'the stub received no --only argument' cannot distinguish a correct full-discovery fallback from an incorrect narrow-to-the-touched-suite-alone bug, once the fixture contains ANY real suite file -- Gate 8's own slow-bucket-relocation filter (Decision 2) always builds an explicit --only list from whatever base suite set it ends up with (narrowed or not), so 'no --only' only ever happens when the fixture is genuinely suite-less. Add a BYSTANDER suite (never named in --gate8-touched) to the fixture and assert the --only value contains it alongside the touched-mapped suite, proving full discovery (not the narrowed set) was used.

Under a heavy concurrent multi-task /orchestrate batch (measured load average 8.28 in one observed session), three specific load-sensitive shell suites (test-gate-lock.sh, test-lint-shellcheck-parallel.sh, test-run-all-parallel.sh) that each complete in well under a minute when run standalone can stall for a full bounded-wait timeout (540s) when run together inside one run-all.sh --only invocation, reproduced three separate times across three different phases of one dispatch. This is real host/scheduling contention from concurrent sibling dispatches, not a code defect -- confirmed by running each suite standalone during the same session and getting fast, clean results. When this pattern recurs, prefer direct standalone suite runs (source-store and/or deployed vantage) over repeatedly retrying the same combined --only invocation.

sapience_notes.subject: suite_selection_select sentinel-domination fix
sapience_notes.value: The selector layer (suite-selection-lib.sh), not the consumer (validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification check), owns the fix for a multi-path call collapsing to the __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel alone when any one touched path is unmappable. Rationale: plan-format.md's own Tier Justification scope is bounded to claims grounded in suite_selection_select's direct return value, the asymmetry is observable from the library alone with no plan/validator in the loop, and a second independent sighting (an under-naming defect from a per-path-composing author) reproduces the identical asymmetry with zero consumer code involved.

sapience_notes.subject: Gate 8's --gate8-touched narrowing, post slow-bucket-relocation split
sapience_notes.value: verify-deploy.sh's gate8_run() ALWAYS builds an explicit --only list for its internal run-all.sh invocation once any suite exists in the discovered corpus, whether or not --gate8-touched actually narrowed anything -- GATE8_FINAL_SUITES is non-empty whenever any suite exists at all, by the comment's own words. 'No --only was passed' is therefore only a valid signal of an unnarrowed/fallback run in a fixture with zero suites; a fixture with real suite files needs to check the CONTENTS of --only (does it carry every discovered suite, not just the touched one) to tell narrowed from unnarrowed.

sapience_notes.subject: suite_selection_select's stratum (b) grep-based reference matching
sapience_notes.value: A single lint fixture basename (lint-agent-contracts.sh) resolves via suite_selection_select to 9 suites, not just its strict basename-paired test-lint-agent-contracts.sh -- several unrelated suites (test-askuserquestion-rehome.sh, test-deploy-baseline-lib.sh, test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh, test-gate-cache-lib.sh, several test-lint-agent-contracts-*.sh variants, and even test-run-all-selection.sh's own source text) textually reference that basename. Any test that assumes a single-suite result for a basename already covered by an existing suite's own membership assertion (which only checks inclusion, never exclusivity) will be wrong; always re-derive the actual per-path output live rather than assuming it from an unrelated earlier assertion.

sapience_notes.subject: context/ directory resolution relative to a scripts root
sapience_notes.value: context/ is always a sibling of the scripts root, identically at both the source-store vantage point (agent-system/extensions/core/{scripts,context}) and a deploy (.claude/{scripts,context}) -- resolving it as $(cd "$SCRIPTS_ROOT/.." && pwd)/context works unmodified at both vantage points with no special-casing needed, unlike the agent-system/extensions/ parent (which only exists in source-store mode and requires the core/manifest.json marker check).

sapience_notes.subject: Heavy concurrent /orchestrate batch load and shell-suite timing assertions
sapience_notes.value: Three load-sensitive shell suites (test-gate-lock.sh, test-lint-shellcheck-parallel.sh, test-run-all-parallel.sh) that each complete in well under a minute standalone stalled for the full 540s bounded-wait timeout three separate times in one session, when run together as part of a combined --only invocation under measured load average 8.28 from many concurrently-active /orchestrate dispatches sharing the same repository. Standalone re-runs during the same session completed quickly and cleanly every time, confirming real host/scheduling contention rather than a code defect. Direct standalone suite runs are a reliable substitute for a combined scoped check when this pattern is observed.
